_envelope_comment: Derived from the Durham-Chapel Hill, NC MSA COUNTY LIST, not from the observed venue bounding box. The observed bbox is only a LOWER bound — it says where the venues we happened to find are, not where the metro is, so an envelope cut to it would reject a legitimate future venue near the metro edge. Envelope = the union of the OSM boundary-polygon bounding boxes for the 5 MSA counties (Durham, Orange, Chatham, Person, Granville), Orange (North Carolina), Chatham (North Carolina), Person (North Carolina), Granville (North Carolina)), rounded OUTWARD to 0.01 deg. Cross-check: contains all 23 geocoded venue(s) of 23 in this batch (observed lat 35.7192..36.3965, lng -79.4589..-78.8451).
